author: dhileepkumargm
name: wave-text-canvas
description: A React component that renders bold, “WAVES” lettering as a flowing wave effect on HTML5 canvas. It uses a mask to detect text pixels and draws vertical scanlines that oscillate inside the letters with a larger amplitude and thicker stroke, while lines outside the text ripple subtly in a contrasting color. Perfect for hero titles, interactive headings, or generative text animations.
